_comment: Append-only research state index (schema v1), SEPARATE from feature_list.json. GIT-FREE — this file + the experiments/ folders ARE the state; resume = read them. research.py init seeds goal/frozen/budget/baseline from research/<goalId>/goal.md; register re-runs the G0-G4 novelty-check then appends experiments[experimentN] + its structural set to approach_registry (the anti-repeat memory the gate reads); record-result recomputes best + goal_met. Discipline mirrors board.py: load -> validate -> mutate ONE spot -> re-check invariants (monotonic experiment index from 1, frozen == goal frozen set, best points at an existing experiment, acyclic-free append-only rows) -> save preserving everything else; fail-closed (exit 1 = REFUSED, ledger UNTOUCHED). Starts empty; never hand-edit.
